Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(mapview)

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# Gråstruktur
gs <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/LandCover/Norway_Grå_Arealer_versjon1/Original/Kart over grå arealer GeoPackage-format/32_25835_graastruktur_gpkg.gpkg", layer = "GraastrukturFlate") %>% 
  st_transform(25832)
```

Explore some potentially unused polygons

```{r echo=FALSE}

# after some exploration, it appears that mineral extraction sites are 
# probably the best candidates

test <- gs %>%
  mutate(likely_unused = (okosystemtype_3 %in% c("Mineral extraction sites", 
                                                 "Port areas", "Other infrastructure") &
      andelbygg == 0)) %>% 
  filter(likely_unused == TRUE)

# there is no way to know if they are currently in or out of use, though :/
```
